models.name: Will the detector miss this smoke?
models.question: Is most of this smoke's mass in particles too small for a light-scattering detector (under 500 nm)?
models.data: 16 SAME-2 flight tests (Kapton, lampwick, Teflon) from Urban et al. 2012, AIAA 2012-3536, Figures 6-8, read from the PDF's vector drawing; Table 1 for the baseline
models.method: Logistic regression on material and air velocity; label from the lognormal mass median diameter (Hatch-Choate, from each test's count-mean and average-mass diameters)
models.validation: leave one flight test out (16 folds); ranges from 2,000 bootstrap resamples
models.baseline_metric_note: material-only balanced accuracy 0.75; model balanced accuracy 0.76 [0.53, 0.94]
